ja288:1.1: Agghanti macchā adhikaṃ sahassaṃ, na so atthi yo ima saddaheyya, mayhañ ca assū idha satta māsā, aham pi taṃ macchuddānaṃ kiṇeyyan ti.
ja288:2.1: Macchānaṃ bhojanaṃ datvā mama dakkhiṇam ādisi, taṃ dakkhiṇaṃ sarantiyā kataṃ apacitiṃ tayā ti
ja288:3.1: Paduṭṭhacittassa na phāti hoti, na cāpi taṃ devatā pūjayanti yo bhātaraṃ pettikaṃ sāpateyyaṃ avañcayī dukkatakammakārīti.
